frontier.hypothesis: The sanctioned C-level search space for this function is complete across five measured axes, and the remaining ladder rung is synthesis rather than another search.
frontier.mechanism: Structural (s2, 11 variants), alter_reg branch analysis (s2 closed form + s3's 23-variant reuse kill), the function.c slot-creation taxonomy (s5 aggregates/BLKmode), randomized machine search (s4+s5, ~159.5k mutations on four chassis) and now compiler forensics (s6, 131 traced allocations tree-wide with the uncorrected path proved unreachable) are all measured dead. Nothing the C controls selects the slot path or the correction.
frontier.next_probe: Synthesis modality: state in one place what an accepted form would have to produce — nine single-word spill slots at stride 8 AND congruence 0 from a 139-instruction leaf — and cross-check that statement against the sanctioned-technique catalog for any family not yet tried. Do not re-run any measured axis.

frontier.hypothesis: func_80060E38 is a member of a 29-function class defined by 'target contains a stride-8 reload-spill block', all blocked by the same measured fork property, and should be dispositioned as a class rather than ground one function at a time.
frontier.mechanism: Census (s2/spillscan2.txt): 29 stride-8 spill blocks tree-wide, all at 0 mod 8, all rule-carrying, none ever matched. s6 supplies the complementary half: our fork produced 131 spill slots tree-wide and every one is at 4 mod 8, because the offset is congruent to -GET_MODE_SIZE(mode) (mod 8) under BYTES_BIG_ENDIAN and the only uncorrected path never executes. cc1psx fed identical input produces target's congruence. Every surface that could change it (the cc1 binary/configuration, the Makefile, prologue_config.json, regfix/asmfix) is outside the grind edit surface, and [[no-compiler-divergence]] forbids the compiler-side fix.
frontier.next_probe: Still an owner-surface question and the driver has NOT declared exhaustion, so it must not be escalated yet. Whichever session is assigned escalation modality should file the CLASS in docs/grind/decisions.md citing s2/spillscan2.txt, the closed form, the cc1psx counter-exhibit, the s3 reuse-branch kill, the s4+s5 ~159.5k-mutation negative, s5's taxonomy closure and s6's tree-wide trace — and must NOT cite Ruling-2, whose scope limit excludes non-crashing fork divergences.

frontier.hypothesis: The s6 instrument is reusable and could answer the same question for other passes without rebuilding anything.
frontier.mechanism: tmp/grind/func_80060E38/s6/gcc is a complete, already-built private GCC 2.7.2 tree whose cc1 is validated byte-identical to the stock build/cc1 on real input; adding an env-gated trace to another pass is a one-file edit plus `make cc1` (~1 min), and s6/sweep.sh already drives all 31 TUs at build-identical flags.
frontier.next_probe: If a later session (this function or another) needs a named pass/decision, patch s6/gcc rather than tools/, reuse s6/sweep.sh + s6/agg.py, and keep the codegen-inertness control (diff the s1 probe output against stock build/cc1) as the first step.
